provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Second Edition Quest: Dragon's Plea. The cover is is two pieces of art, one overlayed over another. The background art features a small adventuring party taking a rest in a dungeon while looking over a map. the top image is of a young, orange scaled, horned dragon holds their head up with pride, despite being forced to ask for help
